verdict.rationale: Make's docs show 'Make Skills' (Markdown files) enabling an AI assistant to build and configure scenarios via the MCP server, and the MCP server lets AI systems like Claude/ChatGPT manage scenario contents — implying prompt-driven workflow creation/editing through external AI clients. However, this is an indirect, third-party-assistant-mediated path rather than a documented native in-product 'type a prompt, get a workflow' feature, and there's no hands-on or independent verification of it working. Missing for 10: a native first-party natural-language-to-workflow builder in the Make UI, concrete examples/screenshots of prompt-generated scenarios, and independent hands-on corroboration.
